rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone cannot find the way.

example.english: I got lost in Mong Kok.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 wong6 gok3 mai4 lou6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when a person or thing is missing, no longer visible, or has been lost.

example.jyutping: ngo5 bun2 syu1 m4 gin3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for time, opportunities, or benefits that have been wasted.

example.jyutping: ngo5 saai1 zo2 seng4 go3 haa6 zau3

rows.note: Use this when someone is absorbed in thought and not paying attention to what is around them.

example.english: Why are you so lost in thought?
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 ceot1 saai3 san4 aa3
